question: Given an array of intervals representing the start and end of some events (or characters partition problem: a string where each letter appears in at most one partition), partition the string into as many parts as possible so that each letter appears in at most one part, and return the sizes of these parts.

key_points: precompute last occurrence index of each character
scan left to right, tracking the farthest last-occurrence among characters seen in the current partition
when current index reaches that farthest point, close the partition
O(n) time, O(1) extra space (fixed alphabet size)
reference_solution.sample_answer: First record the last occurrence index of every character. Then scan through the string, extending the current partition's boundary to the max last-occurrence of any character seen so far; when the scan index reaches that boundary, the partition is complete and its size is recorded. This is O(n) time and O(1) space given a fixed alphabet.
